mapper.sql: r.register_id, r.patient_user_id, r.doctor_id, r.schedule_id, r.appoint_time, r.register_status, r.diagnosis, r.symptom, r.end_time, r.total_cost, r.pay_status, r.version, pu.name AS patient_name, pu.gender AS patient_gender, pu.phone AS patient_phone, du.name AS doctor_name, d.department, d.position, s.schedule_date, s.time_period

FROM registerrecord r JOIN `user` pu ON r.patient_user_id = pu.user_id JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id JOIN `user` du ON d.user_id = du.user_id JOIN schedule s ON r.schedule_id = s.schedule_id
mapper.select: SELECT d.department AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM registerrecord r JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id GROUP BY d.department ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT u.gender AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM registerrecord r JOIN `user` u ON r.patient_user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.gender ORDER BY value DESC

SELECT DATE_FORMAT(s.schedule_date, '%Y-%m-%d') AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM registerrecord r JOIN schedule s ON r.schedule_id = s.schedule_id WHERE s.schedule_date >= DATE_SUB(CURDATE(), INTERVAL #{days} DAY) GROUP BY DATE_FORMAT(s.schedule_date, '%Y-%m-%d') ORDER BY name

SELECT d.department AS name, IFNULL(SUM(r.total_cost), 0) AS value FROM registerrecord r JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id WHERE r.pay_status = '已缴费' GROUP BY d.department ORDER BY value DESC
SELECT u.name AS name, COUNT(*) AS value FROM registerrecord r JOIN doctor d ON r.doctor_id = d.doctor_id JOIN `user` u ON d.user_id = u.user_id GROUP BY u.name ORDER BY value DESC LIMIT #{limit}
